verified_semantics: AArch64 syntax accepted with Android clang target aarch64-linux-android34 and armv8.2-a.
The candidate initializes the stack-backed flash-access mutex, sets the stock update flag and forwards delay values to setup.
Bootloader version gating, write-block alignment, v3 page-base offset, devm payload allocation and exact input copy are preserved.
The candidate forwards the rounded payload and delay mode to syna_tcm_write_flash and preserves non-negative length replacement on success.
Firmware-mode switching, update-flag clearing and managed setup-allocation cleanup are preserved; the payload remains devm-owned as in stock.

review_findings.finding: mutex_init on the stack-backed access context requires independent kernel review against the canonical TCM locking contract.
devm_kmalloc and the intentionally retained devm payload lifetime require canonical device-ownership review.
devm_kfree of access.managed_allocation must be checked against setup ownership and teardown ordering.
